integrity: The universal statements are proved analytically from the cited separated-corner chart, exact inclusion-exclusion, Hamming-layer counting, and the published local tangent-cone description. No finite computation is used as a substitute for proof, and no independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the strict upper regime \((d-1)n/2<m<dn\), where the Hadamard corner cuts are pairwise disjoint.
The geometric formulas allow real parameters, while the connection to lattice smoothness is asserted only for the positive odd integer parameters in the lead source.
The volume and combinatorial formulas do not by themselves imply normality or any Ehrhart-theoretic property.
title: Volume-spline jumps count nonsimple vertices in upper Hadamard truncations
